title: The Distant Static Revisited
author: Silas Sterling
blurb: Rosalind Vasquez, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
